expectation: Membrane ring on scattered single mast cells in the mucosa and submucosa (lamina propria), plus a network of ICC along the myenteric plexus between the muscle layers, with fine septal branches in the gut wall. The stain should be rare to moderate, and other cells should be dark.
observed: A: a sharp, continuous beaded line along the myenteric plane of the muscularis in both sections, with perpendicular septal strands, and punctate cells scattered through the mucosa; the large round blobs sit off the tissue and are debris. B/C: small ring-shaped cells and one bright lamina propria cell, on a moderate haze. D: a crisp membrane ring around one cell.
why: cKit outlines the myenteric ICC network with septal branches and marks scattered membrane-ring cells that look like mast cells; both are specific, expected patterns, not haze or texture.
notes: A bright ICC-like line runs between the muscle layers in both sections and sends out septal branches. Scattered ring-stained cells sit in the mucosa. The large yellow blobs off the tissue are debris.
